== Strategy ==

edit Strategy:

With the cards being started, by the second turn you should have 4 sites out. Two with I’m Sorry, 1 starting, and 1 with the objective.

Crush will help against mains.

Do they have...Clearence?-Most of the characters are ability 3: 8 exactly. They are all now a forfeit + 3. Yes I do realize forfeit reducing cards exist.

The Neimoidians- Haako and Dofine’s game text. Nute’s power, ability, forfeit, destiny, and deploy are excellent!

Haako-E:1’s Scum and villiany. If you just initiated a battle at same or adjacent site, retreive 1 force.

Dofine- if there are no cards in your force pile at the start of your draw phase you may activate two force.

Gunray-just nice all around.

-----

Why do I use Dagobah Executor? The new effect in R:III says once per game deploy Big E for free to Bespin. and Has Immunity.

-----

TPM? Allows Darth Maul to get His Neimoidian friends from the Pile! and it’s a SEVEN!

-----

With no Db in here you should be safe from DB mops!

-----

Match-ups:

RTP-Deploy Palpy to the Death Star Force Lightning Leia then Use Young Fool... Leia is placed out of play.

Wys-Most of the pilots are Ability 3 Deploy Maul.

Hidden Mains- Crush The Rebellion says it all.

QMC- Prevent Them From Flipping! Darth Maul As soon as possible to Bespin! Just hope they have no Ability 4 pilots zooming around the planet!

RST-Out Force Drain On Bespin

Profit-Let them release Han ASAP. Don’t deploy any aliens there at the beginning of the game They will get jumped. And they only retreive force when they control. Let them control and they don’t retrieve 10 force. Probably less.

THGG-Stick To CC. Destroy the J-Bird!<Rotal Starship>

AITC / NLFTE-Who Plays Agents? No one, But If they do stick to CC.

Training: Never deploy Vader or keep him at a place that he cannot be dueled <a.k.a jedi test 6>

Any Questions? Contact me via D-mail. Please rate nicely...
